Subject: Re: PO metadata and invoice cadence for discount eligibility

Erica — thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front: weekly consolidated invoices are fine, we can map to multi-entity PO fields, and the 2% discount is tied to invoice cadence + net terms rather than SKU packaging, though there are a couple of edge cases I note below.

Checklist (high level):
- PO number (PO_NUMBER) — primary matching key (required)
- Bill-to Entity ID (BILL_TO_ENTITY) — for multi-entity mapping (required)
- GL code / cost-center (GL_CODE) — optional but recommended for automated posting
- PO date and effective term (PO_DATE, START_DATE, END_DATE)
- Tax registration / VAT ID if invoicing cross-border (TAX_ID)
- Contact email for remittance (AP_CONTACT_EMAIL)

Edge cases that affect the 2% early-pay discount:
- If invoices are split across multiple legal entities under one PO, we need BILL_TO_ENTITY on each line item or a clear line mapping; otherwise discount approval will require manual reconciliation.
- Usage-based overage billing (metering) is invoiced monthly; if you want the 2% to apply to metered overages we need it in the MSA amendment.

I attached a simple PO XML sample and a one-page billing mapping guide our Finance team uses. Looping in Ben Carter (billing ops) to confirm processing details.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks for sending the PO and XML. Quick operational notes from Billing Ops:

- The fields you included are exactly what we need to support automated posting. Good job.
- For consolidated weekly invoices we will generate a single invoice covering all usage and committed capacity for the week; invoice header will reference PO 78321 and include subtotal lines mapped to GL_CODE.
- To apply the 2% early-pay discount under net-60, we need the MSA to include the discount clause and the AP team to include BILL_TO_ENTITY per line (or provide a mapping table) — this prevents manual splitting. If you can't put BILL_TO_ENTITY by line, we can accept a per-invoice override file that maps invoice lines to entities.
- Preferred format for automated ingestion: XML (same schema as your attachment) or EDI 810. If you want, we can stand up an SFTP drop with our ingestion team for the pilot.

I'll flag this in our billing queue for priority processing once DocuSign finalizes. Vanessa — do we need a pre-approved one-time exception if they want the discount to apply to metered overages?

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Revenue Ops (Billing)

Erica — thanks for the fast turnaround and for including the XML. We're aligned on weekly consolidated invoices and the PO fields look good. A couple of action items to close the loop: 

1) Starlake legal: please include the 2% early-pay discount clause in the MSA addendum explicitly for "all invoiced amounts generated under PO 78321" and confirm whether metered overages should be included. If metered usage should be covered, note it as "included" or "excluded" in the addendum.

2) AP team: please confirm whether BILL_TO_ENTITY will be present on each line in your production XML export. If not, provide the mapping table referenced by Ben (simple CSV with invoice_line_id -> BILL_TO_ENTITY).

3) Markus / Ben: once AP confirms, we'll add an internal pre-approval to allow the 2% discount to be applied automatically; otherwise we'll process discounts manually which delays payment terms.

If all parties confirm by end of week I can sign off from the commercial side and we can expedite DocuSign.
